scope: Source-only correction to the local pinned model installer; separate from previous 16-file gesture acceptance and PR231 communication controls.

reproducedHere: Legacy .download symlink followed by writeFile overwrote the outside synthetic marker with model bytes.
models directory symlink created model bytes outside the fixture project.
runtime directory symlink created a models directory outside the fixture project.

correction: Validate owned non-group/world-writable runtime/storage directories with lstat and canonical containment; reject symlinks and wrong object types.
Validate repository-trusted manifest shape and exact existing HTTPS URL; retain checked-in SHA-256/model version and 10 MB maximum.
Refuse all pre-existing legacy .download objects. An existing target must be an owned single-link regular file with the verified digest; valid reruns perform no fetch or replacement.
Download with the same 30-second AbortSignal and redirect:error; reject invalid responses, oversize streams and hash mismatches before publication.
Allocate a private mkdtemp directory and exclusive no-follow 0600 regular temporary file; flush and recheck its digest before publishing.
Atomically link the verified inode to an absent target. EEXIST never replaces a racing file or symlink. Remove only the owned temporary inode/directory in finally.

originalNegativeControl.command: MINI_GESTURE_INSTALLER_SOURCE=<original installer matching previousSha256> node --test --test-name-pattern="legacy symlink|models-symlink|runtime-symlink" tests/avocado-mini-gesture-installer.test.mjs

validation.testMethod: Every case copies the actual installer bytes unchanged to a fresh private fixture. Only the trusted fixture manifest and global fetch response are synthetic. Filesystem write/publication fault injection occurs in the child test preloader, not production source. Private temporary permissions and cleanup are asserted.
coverage: normal install and verified idempotent rerun
storage-directory symlink, file and unsafe permissions; runtime-directory symlink
partial write, temporary-byte tampering, failed publication and cleanup
target symlink/file creation at fetch/publication boundaries

limitations: POSIX filesystem/UID and hard-link semantics are required; unsupported platforms fail closed.

Code and manifest are repository-trusted. A same-UID actor able to replace code or concurrently exchange parent directories is not fully contained by these path checks; no openat-relative guarantee is claimed.

The pinned real model, SDK, URL, and camera/runtime files were not changed or executed. Existing wrong-digest or unsafe paths are refused and require explicit owner cleanup; they are not overwritten or automatically repaired.
